# Cult UI source snapshots

MIT licensed Cult UI sources from fixed revision `7f031dc812f7bda10213bab62752dd6d080297ff`.

`upstream/` is the authoritative, unchanged registry snapshot. `upstream/provenance.json` records hashes; `upstream/LICENSE.md` and `LICENSE.md` retain the copyright notice. Builds validate all hashes before generating previews and public source downloads.

The full import, adaptation, eligibility and Harness candidate contract is documented in `docs/component-catalog.md`. The website displays the catalog at `/components/` and runs selected source examples in separate preview documents. It does not claim target-project approval or automatic Harness installation.
